candidate_reports.remark: Local broadcast media reported live images of significant street flooding near Causeway Blvd and Veterans in Metairie.
Delayed report. Heavy rainfall produced flash flooding near the intersection of Sheringham and Doescher Drives. The water was approximately 18 inches deep.
Local broadcast media relayed flooding along Hollywood Drive in Metairie.
Public report of tree limb on car and large tree limb on shed in Brusly from thunderstorm winds. Time estimated by radar.
Sagging power line on Hwy 445. Time estimated by radar.
Building damage at Courtney Christian High School in Hammond. Possible tornado damage. Time estimated by radar.
Tornado began in a parking lot on West Thomas Street and traveled south-southwest for around 3 quarters of a mile. Damage was mostly to trees however_ minor structural damage did occur. Tornado lifte
Trees down on Milton Rd in Hammond. Time estimated by radar.
Straight-line winds caused a pine tree to snap and damage a roof on a house as well as their AC unit in Independence_ LA. Time estimated by radar.
Public report of multiple trees down in and around Slaughter blocking the roads and highways. Time estimated by radar.
Local broadcast media posted a picture on social media of flooding along Loyola Dr in Kenner. The water was approximately 1-2 feet deep.
Lots of ponding water along Hwy 90 between Waveland and Gulfport.
Approximately 6 inches of standing water on some roads in downtown Hammond.
